ceiling_directive: Prove the offset-sensitive uniform fixing normal form with an explicit finite state bound and show that every current UNKNOWN state compiles either a common cylinder functional or a fixed-alphabet stationary countermodel pair.
improvement_directive: Complete oeq:uniform-normal-form by supplying an exhaustive finite-state invariant and terminal extraction rules, including states where all refinements are individually identifiable but their identifying functionals disagree. Integrate those rules into TID-SCG so SUCCESS and FAIL become converses of UID rather than isolated sufficient branches.
critique: The delivered theorem is a terminating sound partial procedure, not the promised sound-and-complete identification algorithm: every residual latent-confounded cyclic case returns UNKNOWN. Its general positive coverage mainly combines two cited sufficient criteria with a straightforward saturated-ADMG ID success rule, while its general negative coverage is replaced by one hard-coded three-variable lag-switch collision. The load-bearing offset-sensitive fixing transducer and uniform fixed-alphabet countermodel extraction are left entirely in oeq:uniform-normal-form, so the note does not characterize identification over the stated refinement class. The HAC limit theory and EasyRCA ranking result apply only after identification has already succeeded and add no evidence that the partial coverage is practically consequential, limiting the leading-journal paper score. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
